headline: Former US Officials Push Bipartisan Permitting Reform Bill
summary: Former US economic and national security officials urged Congress to pass the American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026, warning that energy project permitting red tape gives an industrial advantage to China.
why: Permitting regulations directly control the timeline and capital expenditure efficiency of energy grid, oil, gas, and renewable infrastructure investments.

impacts.name: US Energy Infrastructure
impacts.why: Permitting reform would shorten construction timelines and lower project development costs.
